title: Function coverage analogue for Restore with parameter bytes
purpose: Supply a structurally valid explicit request variant for the Restore plan with multiple request-data bytes to exercise field interaction between CPF lengths and CIP body size.
expected_behavior: Parser should successfully process the encapsulation header and CPF items and expose a slightly longer explicit request to the CIP parser; application-level acceptance depends on implementation support for the implied service.
constraints_preserved: Used little-endian encapsulation command and length fields with 24-byte header.
Set encapsulation payload length to 0x0018 corresponding to 24 CPF bytes.
Used documented item types 0x0000 and 0x00b2 in the documented SendRRData combination.
Set Unconnected Data Item length 0x000c to match the embedded 12-byte CIP request.
Used a conservative inferred explicit-request layout and EPATH encoding to Identity Object class 0x01 instance 0x01.
Used conservative inferred service byte 0x15 as a Restore-themed placeholder because the supplied sources do not provide the actual Restore service code.
issue_safety_notes: This seed preserves protocol structure and avoids any claim that the target supports or will execute a Restore operation.
